nodes.source_text: we constructed a two-electrode configuration electrolyzer for comprehensive water splitting using a graphite rod as the cathode and Ni-SalphenCOF or Co-SalphenCOF as the anode... they sustain stability for over 160 h.

nodes.characterization_summary: PXRD confirms high crystallinity; M-SalphenCOF shows enhanced (200) crystal plane peaks due to stronger interlayer interactions.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) patterns display intensive diffraction peaks ... In comparison to SalphenCOF, the (200) crystal plane peak of M-SalphenCOF is enhanced

nodes.characterization_summary: Type II isotherms with surface areas ranging from 93 to 225 m2/g for metalated COFs and pore sizes of ~13.6 Å.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Nitrogen adsorption-desorption isotherms ... exhibit typical Type II isotherms ... BET surface areas of SalphenCOF and M-SalphenCOFs (M = Ni, Co, Cu, Zn) are determined to be 242, 225, 93, 176, and 142 m2g-1

nodes.characterization_summary: Absence of amino/aldehyde bands and appearance of imine bond stretching at 1618 cm-1 confirms condensation; metal coordination leads to a decrease in imine peak intensity.
nodes.evidence_snippet: characteristic imine bond stretching vibration band appears at 1618 cm-1, which significantly decreases upon metal incorporation, indicating coordination of the metal.

nodes.characterization_summary: Lattice fringe distance of 0.33 nm matches the interlayer distance of Ni-SalphenCOF layers.
nodes.evidence_snippet: High-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) images show that the obvious lattice fringe distance (0.33 nm) corresponds well to the interlayer distance of Ni-SalphenCOF layers

nodes.characterization_summary: Reveals dispersed diatomic Ni sites with an observed distance of 3.1-3.2 Å.
nodes.evidence_snippet: aberration-corrected high-angle annular dark-field scanning transmission electron microscopy (AC-HAADF-STEM) presents numerous paired bright spots ... yielding results of 3.1, 3.2, and 3.2 Å

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni K-edge positions indicate a positive valence state for Ni between 0 and +2.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Ni K-edge X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) of Ni-SalphenCOF presents between that of Ni foil and NiO ... valence state of Ni atoms carries a positive charge, ranging from 0 to 2.

nodes.characterization_summary: Confirms atomic dispersion of Ni with coordination to 2 N (1.83 Å) and 2 O (2.00 Å), and a Ni-Ni diatomic distance of 2.84 Å.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Ni-SalphenCOF exhibits a primary peak at 1.6 Å and a minor peak at 2.7 Å ... bonding with two N atoms at an atomic distance of 1.83 Å (Ni-N) and two O atoms at an atomic distance of 2.00 Å (Ni-O). The distance between Ni-Ni is 2.84 Å.

nodes.evidence_snippet: N 1s XPS spectra ... exhibit an additional peak at 400.3 eV, indicating the formation of M-N bonds ... Ni 2p XPS spectrum ... binding energies of Ni 2p3/2 and Ni 2p1/2 are centered at 856.4 and 874.8 eV

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni-SalphenCOF shows the highest conductivity with an Rct of 7.2 Ohm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Ni-SalphenCOF showcases the highest conductivity and swiftest charge transfer ability, boasting a Rct value of 7.2 Ohm.
